label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
raw_output: When a business sells goods or services online or by phone, they must clearly explain the legal rights and conditions of the contract before the customer agrees, involving the seller and the customer. This applies during the order process or when offering a service remotely.
